deepdives.title: GTA6
deepdives.teaser: Clean contract fundamentals sitting on top of manufactured-looking hype and weakening flow. Full breakdown below.
deepdives.body:
Mentions

20 mentions found across 12 unique accounts. 45% (9 of 20) traced back to a single account with roughly 100 followers — not organic spread, one account doing most of the talking. The three most-followed accounts quoting the ticker leaned promotional in tone ("beautiful chart trajectories," a countdown to a specific date 11 days out). The one account with genuinely large reach, @CryptoGodJohn (915,953 followers), was the most neutral of the group — referencing the real Netflix/trailer news event rather than talking price action.

Market

  • Price: $0.002774 (+4.9% 24h)
  • Market cap: $2.8M
  • 24h volume: $551K
  • Age: 10 days
  • Liquidity: $291K (10.47% of mcap)

Holder Structure

  • 11,570 holders total
  • Top holders combined: 32.3% (LP 1.1%, private wallets 31.2%)
  • Gini coefficient: 0.21 (0 = perfectly equal, 1 = one wallet owns all)
  • Adjusted private-wallet estimate: 27.3% — inferred from wallet behaviour patterns (clustering, funding source similarity), not confirmed on-chain fact. Two of the eight flagged wallets read as "likely custody" rather than a single controlling party.

Contract Security

  • Mint authority: revoked
  • Freeze authority: revoked
  • LP locked: 99%
No red flags in the base contract mechanics — this isn't a honeypot or a mint-anytime setup.

Flow & Liquidity (entry-scan pass)

  • Flow quality: 7/100 — actual price move (+6.0%) far exceeds what net buying volume justifies (implied -15.4% from flow data). Net flow was negative $11,656 against a $145K reserve.
  • Liquidity trend: pool shrank from $307K to $291K over ~70 hours (-5.3%) — liquidity leaving, not entering.
  • Buy pressure: seller-dominant, net outflow. Buy/sell volume ratio 0.96x. Wash-trade discount applied to the raw flow ratio given the volume pattern.
  • VWAP: price sitting 21.6% above the 3-day VWAP anchor, with no strong support node underneath — thin air pocket below current price, no trapped buyers acting as a floor.

Read

The contract itself is clean — revoked authorities, locked liquidity, no malicious code found. But the two things that would normally make a launch like this look genuinely strong — organic social proof and real net buying — both come apart under a closer look. Nearly half the visible "buzz" traces to one small account, and the price run has outpaced actual buying pressure, sitting on a shrinking liquidity pool. Not a confirmed rug. Not a clean pass either — the fundamentals are fine, the momentum backing the current price isn't.
deepdives.source: on-chain data via Solana/Blockscout-equivalent scan · social data via Sorsa · pulled 2026-08-17
